name: server-minus
description: Two horizontal server bays beside a minus sign.
useCase: Remove a server or detach a host from an infrastructure list.
misuse: Name the removal action explicitly when it affects a running host.

16.reason: The broad upper bay keeps its indicator and vent, while the lower rim opens around the complete minus sign.

24.reason: The wider bays retain their server profile and clear spacing around the complete minus sign.
